lines.en: Frost paves the road before my steps.
My train drags past and the grass blades freeze.
Beyond the throne, I take walks too.
Slower, let the court keep up.
This body makes no sound when it walks.
Where I walk is called the Dread realm.
The lich at my side, the scuttlers behind.
The road is too narrow for my crown.
I am measuring my domain.
Living ones, step aside. Do not block the way.
The throne is empty, so I stand.
The frost on my crown never melts.

lines.zh: 手记翻到我这页，是空白。
lines.en: The notes reach my page and find it blank.

lines.zh: 册子上没有我的召唤法。
lines.en: The register holds no rite to call me.

lines.zh: 他们写尽了尸巫，漏了我。
lines.en: They wrote of the lich at length and left me out.

lines.zh: 等一个敢抬头看我的人。
lines.en: Waiting for one who dares look up at me.
The court is quiet, just as I like it.
Cold is my only jewelry.
I count the bones at the foot of the steps.
No one knows when I will arrive.
My silence is the command.
The scent of the living drifts in.
This crown is heavier than the lair gate.

lines.zh: 我不急，亡者有的是时间。
lines.en: Why rush? The dead have all the time.

lines.zh: 霜落在我肩上，我不去拍。
lines.en: Frost settles on my shoulder; I do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 我等的人，还没走进陵门。
lines.en: The one I wait for has not entered the crypt.
Look up; do not stare only at my hem.
There is fire in your eyes.
Kneel, or turn away.
I look at you as at some old relic.

lines.zh: 活人总是先看冠，再看脸。
lines.en: The living always see the crown before the face.
Your heartbeat is disturbing me.

lines.zh: 你站立的姿势，我记下了。
lines.en: I have memorized how you stand.
Who gave you leave to stare at the throne?

lines.zh: 你身上有铁与汗的味道。
lines.en: You carry iron and sweat on you.
That face is still worth raising.
Do not tremble; I am only looking.
You came earlier than I expected.
A crack in the crown; it does not matter.
This frame has long forgotten hurting.
You dare touch the Queen's gown?
The frost absorbed part of it for me.
The wound will ice over, not bleed.
This debt is entered in my ledger.
The court will repay it on my behalf.
My bones are harder than lair stone.

lines.zh: 别以为裂了冠，就赢了我。
lines.en: Do not think a cracked crown means victory.
Step back; I intend to keep standing.

lines.zh: 供奉？金子在我脚下生霜。
lines.en: Offerings? Gold grows frost at my feet.
I do not feed; I receive homage.

lines.zh: 面包端上来，会冻成石头。
lines.en: Bring bread near and it freezes to stone.
Keep the food of the living far away.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿，早在加冕时死了。
lines.en: My hunger died at my coronation.
Bones are a more dignified offering than flesh.
Give this basket of fruit to the thralls.
You hold out food with the wrong posture.
A queen accepts no gift from a cook.
Sweetness? I can no longer taste it.
You touched my train.
Back away; the cold bites.
A queen does not brush shoulders.
This collision is charged to your account.
My crown is a fraction off.

lines.zh: 站远些，你的热气脏了霜。
lines.en: Stand farther; your warmth soils the frost.
Make way, the court is passing.
You walked into a wall of cold.
Do not grab my sleeve.
Come closer and the frost will climb you.
A queen does not marry the living.
My betrothal was signed on a gravestone.

lines.zh: 宫廷里没有国王，也不需要。
lines.en: The court has no king, and needs none.
The dead bloodline continues by summoning.
Want to be prince consort? Die once first.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴侣，只需要臣下。
lines.en: I need no consort, only subjects.
This crown is shared with no one.
Love or death? I chose the latter.
Do not ask a queen about private matters.
My bed is the entire lair.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，东西自会浮起。
lines.en: I do not bend; things rise on their own.
Let a servant pick it up.
This thing is unworthy of my hand.
Pick it up? A queen does not pick things up.
Shards fall, and someone will collect them.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，再退三步。
lines.en: Set it down, then take three steps back.
This key, I will take.
I lift a finger and it comes to me.
Soiled hands are unfit to hold a crown.
Leave it for the scavengers.
Court, hear my command: take this one.
The Queen has noticed you.
A living thing trespasses; its crime is breathing.
Lich, you go first.
Scuttler, circle behind him.
No hurry; he cannot escape.

lines.zh: 你的名字，从名册上划掉。
lines.en: Your name is struck from the roll.
The frost has memorized your footprints.
When I speak, it is a verdict.
Dare to look up, and dare to bear the cost.
The whole Dread Lair is hunting you.
You have three steps left to live.
Leave him to the thralls.
I will not lift a hand; watching is enough.
A living thing setting foot here is a crime.
I do not name you. I note where you stand.
Your shadow falls on my frost.
The corpse beast has already followed your scent.
You go left, and the frost goes left.
Do not look back; I am always there.
The court is closing in.
Your steps are growing more disordered.
The cold climbs from your soles, does it not?
Run; the Queen enjoys watching.
The door behind you has already shut.
I count to three, and you stop.
The lich's skull knows you.
You cannot hide your breathing.
This sheet of frost is my eye.
The more you panic, the brighter my crown glows.

lines.zh: 退到墙角，就无路可退了。
lines.en: Back to the corner and there is nowhere left.

lines.zh: 我不追，你也会自己倒下。
lines.en: I need not chase; you will fall on your own.
You step back; the frost gains a foot.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，我替你关了门。
lines.en: At the corridor's end I shut the door for you.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，只数到三。
lines.en: I count your steps only to three.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，暴露了你。
lines.en: Your white breath gives you away.
A queen does not chase. She waits.

lines.zh: 拐过这道弯，就是我的宫廷。
lines.en: Past this turn lies my court.
My hand falls and the frost bursts outward.
One touch of me and you go stiff.
This palm strike is the Queen's grace.
The bone crown dips and the cold presses down.
You may block cold, but not me.
Do not point a sword at me; it freezes first.
I raise my hand and the air hardens.
This blow will teach you the rules.
You retreat, but the frost does not.
My strength comes from the whole lair.

lines.zh: 抓住你，像抓住一根枯枝。
lines.en: I seize you like a dry twig.
Striking you requires no full effort.
Does it hurt? The dead forgot pain long ago.
Kneel and you may take one blow fewer.
There is no spawn egg, yet here I am.
The notes never recorded how I arrive.
The court opens a path for me.
Frost spreads from the throne to the door.
I put on the crown and the Dread Lair wakes.
The lich bows; the scuttlers press to the floor.
They do not know when I will come.
When I arrive, even the wind stops.
That blank page, I will fill it myself.
The Queen is here; the living fall silent.
The lair gate need not open; I come regardless.

lines.zh: 脚下的土，认得我的重量。
lines.en: The soil beneath knows my weight.
I sent the cold ahead of me.

lines.zh: 都退下，我要看看这地方。
lines.en: All of you withdraw; I will inspect this place.

lines.zh: 我从不请自来，也不解释。
lines.en: I come uninvited and explain nothing.
The crypt door opened on its own.
Frost lays the road, then I move.

lines.zh: 我站在王座前，灯全灭了。
lines.en: I stand before the throne and every lamp dies.
No moon tonight. Perfect.
The bones have paved my way.
Fire melts the frost, yet I am not warmed.
I fell, and the crown still sits firm.

lines.zh: 水漫过裙裾，我依旧站着。
lines.en: Water rises past my hem; I still stand.
You shattered the frost, not the throne.
The arrow halts in midair, then drops.
Your spell came apart before my crown.

lines.zh: 王后从不挨饿，也从不进食。
lines.en: A queen never starves, and never eats.
Lightning on the crown is rather lovely.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有光，正合我意。
lines.en: The void has no light; that suits me.
